description: Add missing fields to Booking model, create Payment and BookingSeat models, generate and run migration 0003, install missing Python packages (razorpay, reportlab, qrcode), and write backend/requirements.txt.
steps: In Booking.Status inner class add: PENDING = 'pending', 'Pending'. Change status field default to Status.PENDING.

Add to Booking model (after booked_at): customer_phone = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True); booking_reference = models.UUIDField(default=uuid.uuid4, unique=True, db_index=True); payment_status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=[('pending','Pending'),('paid','Paid'),('failed','Failed')], default='pending').

Add Payment model after Booking: booking = models.OneToOneField(Booking, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='payment'); razorpay_order_id = models.CharField(max_length=100); razorpay_payment_id = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True); razorpay_signature = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True); status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=[('pending','Pending'),('paid','Paid'),('failed','Failed')], default='pending'); amount = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2); created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True); updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True).

Add BookingSeat model after Payment: booking = models.ForeignKey(Booking, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name='booking_seats'); seat = models.ForeignKey(CinemaSeat, on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name='booking_seats'); price_at_booking = models.DecimalField(max_digits=10, decimal_places=2). Add Meta with UniqueConstraint(fields=['booking','seat'], name='unique_booking_seat') and ordering=['seat__row','seat__seat_number']. Add __str__ returning f'{self.booking_id} - {self.seat}'.
Run: python backend/manage.py makemigrations cinema_core (from TicketIQ root with venv activated). Confirm migration file 0003_*.py is created under backend/cinema_core/migrations/.
Run: python backend/manage.py migrate. Confirm it applies cleanly.
Install missing packages into the venv: .\venv\Scripts\pip install razorpay==1.4.2 reportlab==4.2.5 'qrcode[pil]==8.1'. Verify with .\venv\Scripts\pip show razorpay reportlab qrcode.
Create backend/requirements.txt: run .\venv\Scripts\pip freeze > backend\requirements.txt from the TicketIQ root. This captures all pinned versions including the new packages.
Run python backend/manage.py check and confirm exit 0.
Set FEAT-001 status to 'completed' in this file and record findings.
acceptance_criteria: python backend/manage.py check exits 0 with no errors.
python backend/manage.py showmigrations cinema_core shows 0003 as [X] applied.
Booking model has fields: customer_phone, booking_reference, payment_status, and Status.PENDING choice.
Payment model exists with OneToOne to Booking.
BookingSeat model exists with FK to Booking and CinemaSeat, UniqueConstraint on (booking, seat).
backend/requirements.txt exists and contains razorpay, reportlab, qrcode.
All existing migrations (0001, 0002) remain applied and unmodified.

BookingSeat model created with FK to Booking and CinemaSeat, price_at_booking, UniqueConstraint on (booking, seat), and ordering by seat row/number.
